task: Take the BOX_MIDDLE of the box and place it on INSPECTION_TABLE. After that, the stack should look like it is removed the middle box ONLY. NOTE: only the top box of the box stack can be picked(like the data structure).
plan_summary: Move BOX_MIDDLE from BOX_BOTTOM to INSPECTION_TABLE by first picking it up and then placing it at the destination.
assumptions: CAR robot is initially at (0, 0) approximately
BOX_MIDDLE is at (2.0, -1.0) on top of BOX_BOTTOM
BOX_MIDDLE is graspable and within interaction distance when CAR is nearby
Only top box can be picked, and BOX_MIDDLE is currently the top of its stack (BOX_TOP is separate, not stacked on BOX_MIDDLE)
rtdl: def task MoveBoxMiddleToInspectionTable(;){ state nav_success: bool; state nav_msg: string; state pick_success: bool; state pick_msg: string; state place_success: bool; state place_msg: string; sequence{ do NavTo(robot_name="CAR",x=2.0,y=-1.0,tolerance=0.5;success->nav_success,message->nav_msg); check(nav_success == true); do Pick(robot_name="CAR",object_name="BOX_MIDDLE";success->pick_success,message->pick_msg); check(pick_success == true); do NavTo(robot_name="CAR",x=-2.2,y=2.0,tolerance=0.5;success->nav_success,message->nav_msg); check(nav_success == true); do Place(robot_name="CAR",object_name="BOX_MIDDLE",location_name="INSPECTION_TABLE";success->place_success,message->place_msg); check(place_success == true); } }
